what: Solstice Advanced Materials is the specialty materials business spun out of Honeywell in 2025. It makes low-global-warming refrigerants, electronic materials for chipmaking, and performance fibres including Spectra.
customers: Air conditioning and refrigeration makers, semiconductor fabs, and defence and industrial customers.
money: Solstice refrigerants, blowing agents and specialty chemicals
Spectra fibre for body armour and ropes
moat: Patented low-global-warming refrigerants that regulation effectively requires, in a market where the old refrigerants are being phased out by law and the replacements are protected by patents.
risks: 32 times earnings for a newly separated company still carrying spin-off costs
$2.2B of debt taken on at the separation
A 6.1% net margin, which the company says it intends to raise
opportunities: $446M of free cash flow on $4.2B of revenue
Analysts see about 21% upside, with 10 covering the stock
Refrigerant phase-down rules in the United States and Europe force customers onto exactly its patented products
watch: Advanced Materials volume growth as the refrigerant phase-down proceeds.
